verdict.rationale: The official Solo 2 README states that the device "also speaks ... OpenPGP", so keeping OpenPGP keys on the key is claimed. That is the only evidence: nothing documents setup, key generation or import, GnuPG integration, git commit signing, or email encryption. The HN comment saying it "doesn't do OpenPGP" comes from the pre-release announcement thread and expresses hope it would be added later, so it is not a concrete counter-example to the current README. Missing for 10: OpenPGP setup documentation, a git commit-signing workflow, an encrypted-email workflow, supported algorithms and key sizes, and independent or hands-on confirmation that OpenPGP works on shipped firmware.
